$Comment: The feast stall. Season makes the stall, and every offer naming it, absent while the feast is off.
Order 90 keeps it behind a server's everyday storefronts, so a shop block or a conversation line that
opens the first storefront never lands here. It carries no Where, so it opens in any world and follows
Martha wherever a server stands her: players reach it through her, and Season closes it while the feast
Martha's own shelves are priced in Harvest Coins, the feast's own currency, which Currencies puts in
the header. Includes carries the festival shelf (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Festival_Stall) beside her own
goods: the offers every season's host shares, priced in festival tokens, with one purchase limit
across them all, each on sale only in its own Season or Dates (so the winter pieces show here and the
Pumpkin Basket does not). The shelf brings its own wallet, place and name, so the header shows
festival tokens beside the coins and the festival shelf follows Martha's own shelves with no line of
its own here. CategoryOrder fixes the order of her own shelves, and each one's name is a key in
